name: tia_rename_block
description: Rename one PLC program block (OB/FB/FC/DB) in place and verify by read-back; the block number is left unchanged. Fails without changes when any program block or PLC data type in the PLC already uses the new name (case-insensitive). PLC data types are renamed with tia_rename_plc_type. Only the PLC software's own folders are searched; objects inside S7-1500 software units are out of scope.

block_name.description: Exact current name of the program block.

new_name.description: New name; no leading/trailing whitespace, control characters or path separators.

plc_name.description: Exact PLC software name; required when the project has multiple PLCs.

group_path.description: Exact block-folder path of the block. Omit to search all folders; an empty string means the root folder only.

on_conflict.description: Conflict policy; only 'fail' is supported, existing names are never overwritten.
